objective: Shortlist at most three candidates using comparable public-record sufficiency tests and explicit incumbent constraints.
actions: Profiled action-relevant fields in 50 recent CPSC recall records
Profiled action-relevant fields in 50 recent Federal Register proposed-rule records
Shortlisted recall screening and federal comment triage with narrowed claims
Rejected three candidates whose ground truth, input access, or alternative gap was inadequate
hypothesis: Public records alone provide enough decision-ready fields to narrow the five candidates to a defensible shortlist.
checks: Parsed 50 official CPSC recall records and verified the 29/50 identity-evidence union and 50/50 hazard/remedy coverage
Fetched 50 Federal Register list records and their detailed API records and verified the 39/50 action-metadata combination
Confirmed exactly two candidates are shortlisted and three are rejected
limitations: Both API samples are recent convenience samples rather than random samples
Record sufficiency is technical validation, not user validation
No matching accuracy, time savings, willingness to pay, or demand was measured
No accounts, private inputs, outreach, or external transactions were used
next: Build held-out baseline comparisons for both shortlisted transformations and select one or reject both.
